items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: so Shelly would get on the stand and I'd have to tell him how to cock his cymbals

ctx.x: Shelly Mann was in the Navy. He was stationed at Sheepshead Bay with Dick Stabile. Now he learned how to play drums but he didn't know anything about jazz. And Kenny Clark who they called Klook, just suffered a stroke recently in Paris which that broke up the Clarke Bold Band. I would ask -- Shelly would ask me "Can I sit in, can I sit in." And stayed on this so long, I'd say let the man sit in. All right he'd come on. But when he was real tired, or he wanted to talk to a girl or you know something, so Shelly…

And oh, he was so far ahead of his time as far as (chorus) structure. Oh! He was playing then what they're playing now. In 1941. And he had a heart attack and he was living at 107th and Central Park. I use to go by and visit him quite a bit. Yeah, good a -- old days.
